QuestInfo.name: The Sage's Burden
QuestInfo.0: The Stasis Seal is only a temporary measure. #b#p712##k asked me to speak with him about warning the fairies on the surface.
QuestInfo.1: I must travel back up to the #b#m010002003##k and deliver the truth to #b#p313##k before the Sages are caught completely off guard.
QuestInfo.2: I returned to #b#m010002000##k and warned #b#p313##k. He was relieved to hear the Cave Fairies survived, but realized the Sages must prepare for the corrupted Arcon. He thanked me for buying them time.
QuestInfo.demandSummary: Return to #b#p313##k, and inform him of what you've learned.

0.0: You've done wonderful work today. My kin can finally rest knowing the roots are calm. But your job isn't quite finished yet.
0.1: #b#p313##k and the others on the surface still think this is just some wild, spreading disease.\nThey have no idea what's really happening down here.
0.2: You need to tell them about Caligo, and that the Arcon itself is the one corrupted. If they don't know the truth, they won't be prepared when the Stasis Seal eventually fades.
0.3: Could you return to #b#m010002000##k and let #b#p313##k know?\nHe'll need time to figure out the next step.

yes.0: Thank you. Let him know we're holding the line down here for now.\nHave a safe trip back up!

no.0: No rush. Take a breather. You've earned a little rest before the climb back up.

1.0: You're back. I can feel the earth settling beneath #b#m010002000##k. \nThere's no need for a long explanation. You found them, didn't you?
1.1: So... they survived all these years in the dark. I am glad.\nBut you carry a grave expression. What else did you find in the Hollow?
1.2: ...Caligo. I see. So the rot wasn't just a sickness.\nThe Arcon itself has been consumed.
1.3: This is a dire situation. Victoria Island's guardian has become its greatest threat.\nThe Stasis Seal will buy us some time, but a permanent solution will require the Sages to act.
1.4: You have done an incredible service for us today.\nTake these items. Rest for now... we have much to prepare for.

npc.0: #b#p313##k is waiting in #b#m010002000##k. Tell him about Caligo before the Stasis Seal fades. We'll hold the line down here.
